description:
A powerful and easy-to-use screenshot/sticker tool that helps you improve efficiency


3.4.3.2
Optimizations
- The text recognition window now persistently remembers the “Remove Spaces” option.
- The screenshot selection box animation has been optimized; no animation is played on the first selection.
Bug Fixes
- When guide lines are set to “Do Not Show,” Alt‑key shortcuts are intercepted to prevent the guide lines from still being triggered.
- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor could become locked in magnifier mode.
- Resolved a problem where the window failed to open after screen recording and image pasting were saved.
- Corrected an abnormality in copying images via right‑click when using thumbnail or ROI display modes.
3.4.2.2
- [Image Pasting] Fixed issues with the pin‑to‑top behavior and flickering.
3.4.2.1
Features
- [Text Recognition] Added an auto‑close setting to the recognition window, allowing users to choose whether to automatically close the window after “Copy All Text” or “Copy Selected Text.”
Settings
- [Global Mouse] Default macOS keyboard shortcuts have been reset to empty to avoid conflicts with other software.
Optimizations
- [Screenshot] Improved the performance of the macOS screenshot selection‑area transition animation.
- [Text Recognition] Enhanced the recognition accuracy for slanted text.
- [Image Pasting] Optimized the visual effects when closing or destroying pasted images on macOS.
Bug Fixes
- [Image Pasting] Fixed an issue on macOS where the selected text position was misaligned in certain cases.
- [Text/Formula Recognition] Resolved the problem on macOS where the recognition window could not be dragged.
- [Long Screenshot] Fixed the inability to paste long screenshots directly using a keyboard shortcut.
- [Text-to-Speech] Corrected the issue on macOS where the read‑aloud function did not work.
- [Export/Import] Fixed the problem where “non‑bold non‑default settings” did not take effect for built‑in shortcuts.
- [Text Recognition] Fixed abnormal formatting of recognition results in certain scenarios.
- [Floating Ball] Fixed the failure of full‑screen hiding in some applications.
Member Features
- [Table Recognition] Fixed incorrect recognition results for certain tables.
- [Translation] Resolved display abnormalities in the “image‑to‑image” translation mode on macOS.
source: Shenzhen Shendu Tujing Technology Co., Ltd.
